observations: Yamaha brand name is visible on the front panel and the rear casing.
The control panel features distinct teal and purple color-coded sections.

Photo of the included power supply.

Video of the keyboard powered on and playing sounds to verify all keys.

response.reason: The model number is illegible in the photos. For electronic keyboards, the specific model is the primary factor in determining value, and a clear identification is needed to distinguish this from more expensive professional models.
